turns.content: For 2-formyl-5-vinylcyclohex-3-enecarboxylic acid, inventory the rings, carbon-carbon double bonds, and oxygenated functional groups before reaction.

The substrate is treated with red phosphorus and excess HI, which reduces carbon-carbon pi bonds and oxygenated groups without cleaving ordinary cyclohexane C-C bonds. What happens to the aldehyde and carboxylic acid groups?
Under those same conditions, what happens to the two carbon-carbon double bonds?
After the reductions of the oxygenated groups and carbon-carbon double bonds described above, how many rings and pi bonds remain in the carbon skeleton?
State an index-of-hydrogen-deficiency method based on the rings and pi bonds that remain.
Use that method to determine the product's IHD.
Check whether the information actually supplied supports ring opening or residual unsaturation; do not assume any omitted reaction condition.
Report the final IHD and the structural feature responsible for it.
